title: How many household add-ons may a primary member hold open at once?
content:
## Product and scope
This document states the Household Add-On Membership basis for how many add-ons of a given tier a primary member may hold open at the same time.

## Rule
A primary member may hold open, at once, any number of household add-ons of a given tier, up to that tier's maximum-open cap when the tier's cap is set above zero. Where a tier's maximum-open cap is set to zero, the primary member's number of open add-ons of that tier is unlimited.

## Points of judgement
- The cap is set independently for each add-on tier; a primary member's open-add-on limit for one tier says nothing about the limit for a different tier.
- A cap of zero is not a prohibition on holding the add-on; it is the tier's way of stating that no numeric ceiling applies.
- Where a tier's cap is set above zero, a primary member who already holds that many open add-ons of that tier may not hold an additional one of the same tier until an existing one closes.

The actual cap value in force for each add-on tier is recorded in that tier's own parameter basis.
